sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-heretic-GGUF is a static quantized version of the Gemma 4 26B model from mradermacher, distributed in GGUF format for CPU and low-VRAM inference. The original base model is a 26-billion parameter instruction-tuned variant designed for conversational and general text generation tasks.
